verses.original: אַ֣לְלַי לִ֗י כִּ֤י הָיִ֙יתִי֙ כְּאָסְפֵּי־ קַ֔יִץ כְּעֹלְלֹ֖ת בָּצִ֑יר אֵין־ אֶשְׁכּ֣וֹל לֶאֱכ֔וֹל בִּכּוּרָ֖ה אִוְּתָ֥ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: ’al·lay lî kî hā·yî·ṯî kə·’ā·sə·pê- qa·yiṣ kə·‘ō·lə·lōṯ bā·ṣîr ’ên- ’eš·kō·wl le·’ĕ·ḵō·wl bik·kū·rāh ’iw·wə·ṯāh nap̄·šî
verses.literal: Woe is me For I am like one gathering summer fruit at the gleaning of the vineyard there is no cluster to eat no early fig that I crave
verses.literalPt: Ai de mim! Porque me tenho tornado como as colheitas dos frutos do verão, como os rabiscos da vindima: não há nem sequer um cacho de uvas para comer; a minha alma deseja um figo temporão.

verses.original: אָבַ֤ד חָסִיד֙ מִן־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וְיָשָׁ֥ר בָּאָדָ֖ם אָ֑יִן כֻּלָּם֙ לְדָמִ֣ים יֶאֱרֹ֔בוּ אִ֥ישׁ אֶת־ אָחִ֖יהוּ יָצ֥וּדוּ חֵֽרֶם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḇaḏ ḥā·sîḏ min- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·yā·šār bā·’ā·ḏām ’ā·yin kul·lām lə·ḏā·mîm ye·’ĕ·rō·ḇū ’îš ’eṯ- ’ā·ḥî·hū yā·ṣū·ḏū ḥê·rem
verses.literal: The godly man has perished from the earth there is no one upright among men They all lie in wait for blood they hunt one another with a net
verses.literalPt: Já pereceu da terra o homem piedoso, e entre os homens não há quem seja reto; todos espreitam para derramarem sangue; caçam, cada um a seu irmão, com uma rede.

verses.original: עַל־ הָרַ֤ע כַּפַּ֙יִם֙ לְהֵיטִ֔יב הַשַּׂ֣ר שֹׁאֵ֔ל וְהַשֹּׁפֵ֖ט בַּשִׁלּ֑וּם וְהַגָּד֗וֹל דֹּבֵ֨ר הַוַּ֥ת נַפְשׁ֛וֹ ה֖וּא וַֽיְעַבְּתֽוּהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- hā·ra‘ kap·pa·yim lə·hê·ṭîḇ haś·śar šō·’êl wə·haš·šō·p̄êṭ ba·šil·lūm wə·hag·gā·ḏō·wl dō·ḇêr haw·waṯ nap̄·šōw hū way·‘ab·bə·ṯū·hā
verses.literal: Both hands are skilled at evil the prince and the judge demand a bribe When the powerful utters his evil desire they all conspire together
verses.literalPt: As suas mãos estão sobre o mal, para o fazerem com diligência. O príncipe exige, o juiz está pronto para receber a peita, e o grande manifesta o desejo da sua alma; juntamente planejam.

verses.original: טוֹבָ֣ם כְּחֵ֔דֶק יָשָׁ֖ר מִמְּסוּכָ֑ה י֤וֹם מְצַפֶּ֙יךָ֙ פְּקֻדָּתְךָ֣ בָ֔אָה עַתָּ֥ה תִהְיֶ֖ה מְבוּכָתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·w·ḇām kə·ḥê·ḏeq yā·šār mim·mə·sū·ḵāh yō·wm mə·ṣap·pe·ḵā pə·qud·dā·ṯə·ḵā ḇā·’āh ‘at·tāh ṯih·yeh mə·ḇū·ḵā·ṯām
verses.literal: The best of them is like a brier the most upright is sharper than a hedge of thorns The day for your watchmen has come the day of your visitation Now is the time of their confusion
verses.literalPt: O melhor deles é como um espinho; o mais reto é pior do que uma sebe de espinhos. É chegado o dia dos teus vigias, a saber, a tua visitação; agora, começará a sua perplexidade.

verses.original: אַל־ תַּאֲמִ֣ינוּ בְרֵ֔עַ אַֽל־ תִּבְטְח֖וּ בְּאַלּ֑וּף מִשֹּׁכֶ֣בֶת חֵיקֶ֔ךָ שְׁמֹ֖ר פִּתְחֵי־ פִֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- ta·’ă·mî·nū ḇə·rê·a‘ ’al- tiḇ·ṭə·ḥū bə·’al·lūp̄ miš·šō·ḵe·ḇeṯ ḥê·qe·ḵā šə·mōr piṯ·ḥê- p̄î·ḵā
verses.literal: Do not rely on a friend do not trust in a companion Seal the doors of your mouth from her who lies in your arms
verses.literalPt: Não creiais no amigo, não confieis no camarada. Fecha as portas da tua boca àquela que se deita no teu seio.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ בֵן֙ מְנַבֵּ֣ל אָ֔ב בַּ֚ת קָמָ֣ה בְאִמָּ֔הּ כַּלָּ֖ה בַּחֲמֹתָ֑הּ אֹיְבֵ֥י אִ֖ישׁ אַנְשֵׁ֥י בֵיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḇên mə·nab·bêl ’āḇ baṯ qā·māh ḇə·’im·māh kal·lāh ba·ḥă·mō·ṯāh ’ō·yə·ḇê ’îš ’an·šê ḇê·ṯōw
verses.literal: For a son dishonors his father a daughter rises against her mother and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law A man’s enemies are the members of his own household
verses.literalPt: Pois o filho desonra a seu pai, a filha se levanta contra sua mãe, a nora, contra sua sogra; os inimigos são os da própria casa.

verses.original: וַאֲנִי֙ בַּיהוָ֣ה אֲצַפֶּ֔ה אוֹחִ֖ילָה לֵאלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעִ֑י יִשְׁמָעֵ֖נִי אֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ă·ṣap·peh ’ō·w·ḥî·lāh lê·lō·hê yiš·‘î yiš·mā·‘ê·nî ’ĕ·lō·hāy
verses.literal: But as for me I will look to the LORD I will wait for the God of my salvation My God will hear me
verses.literalPt: Mas, quanto a mim, olharei para Jeová; esperarei no Deus da minha salvação; o meu Deus me ouvirá.

verses.original: אַֽל־ תִּשְׂמְחִ֤י אֹיַ֙בְתִּי֙ לִ֔י כִּ֥י נָפַ֖לְתִּי קָ֑מְתִּי כִּֽי־ אֵשֵׁ֣ב בַּחֹ֔שֶׁךְ יְהוָ֖ה א֥וֹר לִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiś·mə·ḥî ’ō·yaḇ·tî lî kî nā·p̄al·tî qā·mə·tî kî- ’ê·šêḇ ba·ḥō·šeḵ Yah·weh ’ō·wr lî
verses.literal: Do not gloat over me my enemy Though I have fallen I will arise though I sit in darkness the LORD will be my light
verses.literalPt: Não te alegres, inimiga minha, a respeito de mim; quando eu cair, levantar-me-ei; quando me sentar nas trevas, Jeová será a minha luz.

verses.original: זַ֤עַף יְהוָה֙ אֶשָּׂ֔א כִּ֥י חָטָ֖אתִי ל֑וֹ עַד֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָרִ֤יב רִיבִי֙ וְעָשָׂ֣ה מִשְׁפָּטִ֔י יוֹצִיאֵ֣נִי לָא֔וֹר אֶרְאֶ֖ה בְּצִדְקָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: za·‘ap̄ Yah·weh ’eś·śā kî ḥā·ṭā·ṯî lōw ‘aḏ ’ă·šer yā·rîḇ rî·ḇî wə·‘ā·śāh miš·pā·ṭî yō·w·ṣî·’ê·nî lā·’ō·wr ’er·’eh bə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Because I have sinned against Him I must endure the rage of the LORD until He argues my case and executes justice for me He will bring me into the light I will see His righteousness
verses.literalPt: Trarei sobre mim a indignação de Jeová, porque tenho pecado contra ele, até que ele julgue a minha causa e execute o juízo a meu favor. Ele me tirará para a luz, e eu verei a sua justiça.

verses.original: וְתֵרֶ֤א אֹיַ֙בְתִּי֙ וּתְכַסֶּ֣הָ בוּשָׁ֔ה הָאֹמְרָ֣ה אֵלַ֔י אַיּ֖וֹ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יִךְ עֵינַי֙ תִּרְאֶ֣ינָּה בָּ֔הּ עַתָּ֛ה תִּֽהְיֶ֥ה לְמִרְמָ֖ס כְּטִ֥יט חוּצֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṯê·re ’ō·yaḇ·tî ū·ṯə·ḵas·se·hā ḇū·šāh hā·’ō·mə·rāh ’ê·lay ’ay·yōw Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hā·yiḵ ‘ê·nay tir·’en·nāh bāh ‘at·tāh tih·yeh lə·mir·mās kə·ṭîṭ ḥū·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: Then my enemy will see and will be covered with shame she who said to me Where is the LORD your God My eyes will see her at that time she will be trampled like mud in the streets
verses.literalPt: Então, o verá a minha inimiga, e cobri-la-á a vergonha a ela, que me disse: Onde está Jeová, teu Deus? Os meus olhos a contemplarão; agora, será pisada aos pés como a lama das ruas.

verses.original: י֖וֹם לִבְנ֣וֹת גְּדֵרָ֑יִךְ י֥וֹם הַה֖וּא יִרְחַק־ חֹֽק׃
verses.transliteration: yō·wm liḇ·nō·wṯ gə·ḏê·rā·yiḵ yō·wm ha·hū yir·ḥaq- ḥōq
verses.literal: The day for rebuilding your walls will come the day for extending your boundary
verses.literalPt: É dia de reedificares os teus muros! Naquele dia, será o decreto removido para longe.

verses.original: י֥וֹם הוּא֙ וְעָדֶ֣יךָ יָב֔וֹא לְמִנִּ֥י אַשּׁ֖וּר וְעָרֵ֣י מָצ֑וֹר וּלְמִנִּ֤י מָצוֹר֙ וְעַד־ נָהָ֔ר וְיָ֥ם מִיָּ֖ם וְהַ֥ר הָהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: yō·wm hū wə·‘ā·ḏe·ḵā yā·ḇō·w lə·min·nî ’aš·šūr wə·‘ā·rê mā·ṣō·wr ū·lə·min·nî mā·ṣō·wr wə·‘aḏ- nā·hār wə·yām mî·yām wə·har hā·hār
verses.literal: On that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt even from Egypt to the Euphrates from sea to sea and mountain to mountain
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia, virão a ti da Assíria e das cidades do Egito até o rio, e de mar a mar, e de monte a monte.

verses.original: וְהָיְתָ֥ה הָאָ֛רֶץ לִשְׁמָמָ֖ה עַל־ יֹֽשְׁבֶ֑יהָ מִפְּרִ֖י מַֽעַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yə·ṯāh hā·’ā·reṣ liš·mā·māh ‘al- yō·šə·ḇe·hā mip·pə·rî ma·‘al·lê·hem
verses.literal: Then the earth will become desolate because of its inhabitants as the fruit of their deeds
verses.literalPt: Todavia, a terra será entregue à desolação por causa dos que nela habitam, em atenção ao fruto dos seus feitos.

verses.original: רְעֵ֧ה עַמְּךָ֣ בְשִׁבְטֶ֗ךָ צֹ֚אן נַֽחֲלָתֶ֔ךָ שֹׁכְנִ֣י לְבָדָ֔ד יַ֖עַר בְּת֣וֹךְ כַּרְמֶ֑ל יִרְע֥וּ בָשָׁ֛ן וְגִלְעָ֖ד כִּימֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: rə·‘êh ‘am·mə·ḵā ḇə·šiḇ·ṭe·ḵā ṣōn na·ḥă·lā·ṯe·ḵā šō·ḵə·nî lə·ḇā·ḏāḏ ya·‘ar bə·ṯō·wḵ kar·mel yir·‘ū ḇā·šān wə·ḡil·‘āḏ kî·mê ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Shepherd with Your staff Your people the flock of Your inheritance They live alone in a woodland surrounded by pastures Let them graze in Bashan and Gilead as in the days of old
verses.literalPt: Apascenta com a tua vara o teu povo, o rebanho da tua herança, que habita a sós no bosque no meio do Carmelo; apascentem-se em Basã e em Gileade, como nos dias antigos.

verses.original: כִּימֵ֥י צֵאתְךָ֖ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אַרְאֶ֖נּוּ נִפְלָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: kî·mê ṣê·ṯə·ḵā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim ’ar·’en·nū nip̄·lā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: As in the days when you came out of Egypt I will show My wonders
verses.literalPt: Como nos dias da tua saída da terra do Egito, mostrar-lhe-ei maravilhas.

verses.original: יִרְא֤וּ גוֹיִם֙ וְיֵבֹ֔שׁוּ מִכֹּ֖ל גְּבֽוּרָתָ֑ם יָשִׂ֤ימוּ יָד֙ עַל־ פֶּ֔ה אָזְנֵיהֶ֖ם תֶּחֱרַֽשְׁנָה׃
verses.transliteration: yir·’ū ḡō·w·yim wə·yê·ḇō·šū mik·kōl gə·ḇū·rā·ṯām yā·śî·mū yāḏ ‘al- peh ’ā·zə·nê·hem te·ḥĕ·raš·nāh
verses.literal: Nations will see and be ashamed deprived of all their might They will put their hands over their mouths and their ears will become deaf
verses.literalPt: As nações verão e serão envergonhadas de todo o seu poder; porão a mão sobre a boca, os seus ouvidos ficarão surdos.

verses.original: יְלַחֲכ֤וּ עָפָר֙ כַּנָּחָ֔שׁ כְּזֹחֲלֵ֣י אֶ֔רֶץ יִרְגְּז֖וּ מִמִּסְגְּרֹֽתֵיהֶ֑ם אֶל־ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ יִפְחָ֔דוּ וְיִֽרְא֖וּ מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·la·ḥă·ḵū ‘ā·p̄ār kan·nā·ḥāš kə·zō·ḥă·lê ’e·reṣ yir·gə·zū mim·mis·gə·rō·ṯê·hem ’el- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū yip̄·ḥā·ḏū wə·yir·’ū mim·me·kā
verses.literal: They will lick the dust like a snake like reptiles slithering on the ground They will come trembling from their strongholds in the presence of the LORD our God they will tremble in fear of You
verses.literalPt: Como a serpente, lamberão o pó; como répteis da terra, tremendo, sairão dos seus esconderijos; com pavor, virão a Jeová, nosso Deus, e terão medo de ti.

verses.original: מִי־ אֵ֣ל כָּמ֗וֹךָ נֹשֵׂ֤א עָוֺן֙ וְעֹבֵ֣ר עַל־ פֶּ֔שַׁע לִשְׁאֵרִ֖ית נַחֲלָת֑וֹ לֹא־ הֶחֱזִ֤יק לָעַד֙ אַפּ֔וֹ כִּֽי־ חָפֵ֥ץ חֶ֖סֶד הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: mî- ’êl kā·mō·w·ḵā nō·śê ‘ā·wōn wə·‘ō·ḇêr ‘al- pe·ša‘ liš·’ê·rîṯ na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw lō- he·ḥĕ·zîq lā·‘aḏ ’ap·pōw kî- ḥā·p̄êṣ ḥe·seḏ hū
verses.literal: Who is a God like You who pardons iniquity and passes over the transgression of the remnant of His inheritance who does not retain His anger forever because He delights in loving devotion
verses.literalPt: Quem é Deus semelhante a ti, que perdoas a iniquidade e que te esqueces da transgressão do resto da tua herança? Ele não retém para sempre a sua ira, porque se deleita na misericórdia.

verses.original: יָשׁ֣וּב יְרַֽחֲמֵ֔נוּ יִכְבֹּ֖שׁ עֲוֺֽנֹתֵ֑ינוּ וְתַשְׁלִ֛יךְ בִּמְצֻל֥וֹת יָ֖ם כָּל־ חַטֹּאותָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yā·šūḇ yə·ra·ḥă·mê·nū yiḵ·bōš ‘ă·wō·nō·ṯê·nū wə·ṯaš·lîḵ bim·ṣu·lō·wṯ yām kāl- ḥaṭ·ṭō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: He will again have compassion on us He will vanquish our iniquities You will cast out all our sins into the depths of the sea
verses.literalPt: Ele voltará e terá compaixão de nós; pisará aos pés as nossas iniquidades. Tu lançarás todos os seus pecados no fundo do mar.

verses.original: תִּתֵּ֤ן אֱמֶת֙ לְיַֽעֲקֹ֔ב חֶ֖סֶד לְאַבְרָהָ֑ם אֲשֶׁר־ נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתָּ לַאֲבֹתֵ֖ינוּ מִ֥ימֵי קֶֽדֶם׃
verses.transliteration: tit·tên ’ĕ·meṯ lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ ḥe·seḏ lə·’aḇ·rā·hām ’ă·šer- niš·ba‘·tā la·’ă·ḇō·ṯê·nū mî·mê qe·ḏem
verses.literal: You will show faithfulness to Jacob and loving devotion to Abraham as You swore to our fathers from the days of old
verses.literalPt: Mostrarás a Jacó a tua fidelidade e a Abraão, a tua misericórdia, as quais coisas tens jurado a nossos pais desde os dias antigos.
